title: compliance-engine adapter manifest
description: Capability declaration an adapter registers (PUT /api/v1/adapters/{name}/manifest) before it pushes batches. The engine also checks that each supplied entity and field exists in the declared canonical schema version and that every supplied entity includes its identity fields.

name.description: Adapter name, unique in a workspace. It appears in the URL path and is the source.adapter of every batch the adapter sends.

schema_version.description: Canonical schema version the adapter emits (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).

supplies.description: Entity name -> the fields the adapter can provide. Fields of registered entities that no manifest supplies are reported as not_supplied_by_any_adapter. A full-mode batch is authoritative for these entities: records of them previously sent by this adapter and absent from the batch are deleted.
